metadata.title: On Medial Quandle Coloring Link Invariant and Detecting Causality
metadata.abstract: We investigate the capability of medial quandles to detect causality in (2+1) dimensional globally hyperbolic spacetime by determining if their coloring link invariants can distinguish between the connected sum of two Hopf links and an infinite series of relevant three-component links constructed by Allen and Swenberg in 2020, who suggested that any link invariant must be able to distinguish those links for them to detect causality in the given setting. We show that these quandles fail to do so as long as $a\sim b\Leftrightarrow a*b=a$ defines an equivalence relation. The Alexander quandles are an example to which this result applies. We also give a sufficient condition for a medial quandle to distinguish between the connected sum of two Hopf links and all links in Allen-Swenberg series, and give an example of such a quandle. Inspired by this result, we also derive a generalized theorem about the coloring of medial quandles on a specific type of tangle, which helps to determine whether these quandles can distinguish between a wider range of knots and links or not.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 研究 medial quandle 着色不变量对用于因果检测的链环族的区分能力，给出失效条件与可行例子。
analysis.breakthrough: 明确一类不变量无法检测指定因果区分的原因，并给出充分条件。
analysis.limitations: 仅针对指定时空和链环测试，不能视为一般因果判定算法。 当前为摘要级分析，技术细节与结论须回查原文。
analysis.priorityReason: 应用与代数对象较专门，对曲率和度量测度研究的直接贡献有限。
analysis.lowPriorityReason: 应用与代数对象较专门，对曲率和度量测度研究的直接贡献有限。 此为本课题组阅读顺序判断，不是论文质量结论。
